name: pmc-triage-feedback
description: Triages a week of customer feedback from support, chat and research connectors into a Feedback Triage Log with fixed tags, the job behind each request, new against known themes, and reply drafts for a person to send. Use for "run pmc-triage-feedback", "triage this week's feedback", "triage feedback from Intercom and #feedback", "what is new compared with last month", "draft replies for the loudest requests", "sort the feature requests", "feedback is everywhere", part of the Claude Opus 5.5 for Product Managers Pack by 90n.
